title: Looplook: An integrative suite for target assignment and functional annotation of chromatin interactions
text: looplook R/Bioconductor package integrates three-dimensional (3D) chromatin architecture data — derived HiChIP, ChIA-PET, Hi-C — complementary omics datasets, including transcriptomic profiles, chromatin accessibility maps, protein-DNA interaction data (ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, CUT&RUN), genetic variants annotated genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Distal regulatory elements physically contact target gene promoters 3D chromatin looping, enabling transcriptional regulation distances spanning tens kilobases megabases along linear genome. Conventional annotation strategies, however, assign putative regulatory elements nearest neighboring genes cis — linear approximation frequently diverges underlying 3D topology. Accurate assignment non-coding variants orphan regulatory peaks cognate target genes therefore remains central bottleneck functional interpretation genomic regulatory landscapes. looplook addresses challenge systematically prioritizing experimentally detected chromatin contacts assign target genes regulatory elements genome-wide scale, producing evidence-prioritized annotations systematic provenance tracking. Beyond target gene assignment, looplook functions standalone platform chromatin loop analysis. Even absence auxiliary omics data, package enables systematic annotation 3D interactome, classification spatial interaction topologies (e.g., Enhancer–Promoter, Promoter–Promoter), quantification node connectivity identify dense regulatory hubs enhancer cliques — candidate regulatory domains may drive cell-type-specific transcriptional programs.

code: # Locate example BEDPE replicates f1 <- system.file("extdata", "example_loops_1.bedpe", package = "looplook") f2 <- system.file("extdata", "example_loops_2.bedpe", package = "looplook") global_out <- file.path(out_dir, "consensus_loops_global.bedpe")  # Execute consensus merging with strict Quality Control consensus_global <- consolidate_chromatin_loops(   files = c(f1, f2),   mode = "consensus",   gap = 1000,   min_raw_score = 2, # Pre-filter sequencing noise   blacklist_species = "hg38", # Apply artifact blacklist   out_file = global_out,   write_output = TRUE )

text: annotate_peaks_and_loops serves core mapping engine looplook. classifies topological architecture 3D interactome — assigning loop anchor positional type (P, E, G) loop structural class (E–P, P–P, etc.) — , target_bed file supplied, traces non-coding regulatory features (GWAS loci, eQTLs, ChIP-seq peaks) putative target genes 3D chromatin contacts. resolve mapping ambiguities within densely populated gene loci, single loop anchor overlaps multiple candidate genes, engine implements rigorous three-step hierarchical annotation pipeline: Functional Biotype Prioritization: Selects highest-priority candidates functional class: Protein Coding > small-ncRNA (miRNA, snoRNA, snRNA, rRNA, scaRNA) > Antisense > lncRNA/ncRNA > Pseudogene. default hierarchy can customised via biotype_order parameter resolve_gene_conflicts(). five biotype keywords "protein" (protein-coding), "small_ncRNA" (miRNA, snoRNA, snRNA, rRNA, scaRNA), "antisense", "lncRNA" (lncRNA ncRNA), "pseudogene". order listed keywords determines priority (first = highest); unlisted categories keep default relative order appended listed ones. example, biotype_order = c("lncRNA", "protein") elevates lncRNAs protein-coding genes keeping remaining three categories (small_ncRNA > antisense > pseudogene) default order. Expression Filter: Within selected biotype tier, excludes transcriptionally silent genes (expression < min_expr) least one candidate tier expressed. gene tier expressed, retained avoid losing correct annotations due low expression. Co-Dominant Expression Tiebreaker: Among remaining candidates, retains genes expression >= co_dominance_ratio x group maximum. default ratio 0.1 (one order magnitude; ~3.3-fold log2 space) preserves functionally redundant candidates (e.g., bidirectional promoter pairs, typically co-expressed within 2–3 fold) rather forcing single-gene assignment.

text: multi-omic integration relies several key parameters: bedpe_file: 3D structural framework (e.g., high-confidence consensus interactome generated Module 1). target_bed: auxiliary genomic features interest (e.g., BED file GWAS SNPs, ATAC-seq peaks, ChIP-seq peaks) awaiting spatial target assignment. expr_matrix_file & sample_columns: Optional strongly recommended. expression matrix (e.g., RNA-seq TPM/FPKM, NET-seq/PRO-seq gene-body RPKM, CAGE-seq) enables Expression Pre-filter Tiebreaker logic, can help reduce false-positive gene assignments dense genomic loci. min_expr: Minimum expression value gene considered “active” anchor-level conflict resolution (default: 0). default, non-zero expression (TPM > 0) qualifies; truly undetected genes (TPM = 0) excluded. set 1 higher, genes expression >= min_expr considered active. Note distinct Module 3’s threshold parameter, controls promoter reclassification expression-aware refinement. 0 (Default): Loop topology restricted direct contacts; target genes searched within 1-hop. 1 (Hub Mode): Loop topology includes secondary contacts; target genes searched within 2-hop. Values greater 1 supported. anchor_gap (integer, default -1): Candidate search radius (bp) target peak loop anchor. -1 (default): strict physical overlap. >= 0: expands candidate search window (e.g. 200 cross-experiment coordinate shifts). Note: final retention always requires least anchor_min_overlap bp physical overlap. parameter controls candidate search, whether proximity-pairs retained. anchor_min_overlap (integer, default 1): Minimum required physical overlap (bp) peak anchor. Default 1: least 1 bp actual sequence overlap required — proximity-pairs within anchor_gap window without physical overlap excluded. Increase 10–100 broad peaks avoid spurious boundary overlaps. anchor_min_frac (numeric, 0–1, default 0): first two filters, fraction peak width must physically overlap anchor? 0 accepts fraction. Set 0.1–0.5 peaks broad (H3K27ac domains, 2–5 kb). recommended point features (SNPs). Applied last. three parameters act cascade: (1) search radius, (2) minimum overlap bp, (3) fraction peak. conflict; narrows candidate set . anchor_merge_gap (integer, default 0): Merge loop anchors within many bp chromosome building connectivity graph. 0 (default): merging; anchors must match exactly chr/start/end. Set 50–200 input BEDPE comes directly loop caller without prior replicate consolidation via consolidate_chromatin_loops() — biological anchor may appear slightly different boundaries different loop rows, fragmenting graph underestimating hub connectivity. input pre-consolidated (recommended), leave 0. tss_region: Defines genomic window surrounding transcription start site (TSS) used define promoter regions (default: c(-2000, 2000) bp). conflict_strategy: Controls order biotype expression filtering multiple genes overlap anchor. "biotype_first" (default) selects best biotype tier first, applies expression filtering within tier — silent protein-coding gene preferred highly expressed lncRNA. "expression_first" applies expression filtering across biotypes selecting best tier. hub_metric: connectivity count use hub detection. "unique_contacts" (default): counts distinct neighbour anchor IDs, robust duplicate/replicate loop rows. "total_loops": counts loop rows (backward compatible; may inflate hub calls unconsolidated replicates). target_priority: Policy prioritising multiple candidate target genes per feature. Applies within primary target links (default path_length <= 1); longer paths reported separately Expanded_Target_Genes compete Assigned_Target_Genes. "promoter_then_distance" (default): within primary links, promoter-linked genes beat gene-body genes, shorter paths breaking ties. Exception: direct strict promoter–promoter contacts (loop, path0+path1) co-assign endpoints via union, endpoint orientation technical rather directional. "distance_then_role": path-length dominates — closest linked gene wins; equal distance, promoter beats gene-body (legacy behaviour). hub_percentile: Node-degree quantile threshold identifying highly connected regulatory elements (default: 0.95, .e. top 5%). species: Genome assembly ("hg38", "hg19", "mm10", "mm9"). Auto-resolves corresponding TxDb OrgDb annotation packages. species, pass txdb org_db objects package name strings directly (e.g., txdb = TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene, org_db = "org.Dm.eg.db"). txdb org_db provided, species used karyotype chromosome ideograms can left default. color_palette: RColorBrewer palette loop-type colour assignments annotation plots (default: "Set2"). karyo_bin_size: Genomic bin width base pairs karyotype heatmaps (default: 1e5).

code: # Locate auxiliary genomic features and RNA-seq expression matrix expr_path <- system.file("extdata", "example_tpm.txt", package = "looplook") atac_path <- system.file("extdata", "example_peaks.bed", package = "looplook") # Live annotation requires the TxDb/OrgDb packages; when they are missing, # res_integrated stays NULL and the pre-computed fallback below is used. res_integrated <- NULL if (requireNamespace("TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene", quietly = TRUE) &&   requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {   res_integrated <- annotate_peaks_and_loops(     bedpe_file = global_out, # Uses the global consensus network from Module 1     target_bed = atac_path, # External genomic features     expr_matrix_file = expr_path, # Activates the rigorous 3-step tiebreaker     sample_columns = c("con1", "con2"),     species = "hg38",     neighbor_hop = 0, # Focus on direct physical contacts     hub_percentile = 0.95, # Top 5% nodes defined as hubs     # Peak-anchor overlap: same-experiment defaults (strict physical overlap)     anchor_gap = -1L, # GenomicRanges default: strict overlap     anchor_min_overlap = 1L, # any 1 bp touch counts     anchor_min_frac = 0, # any fraction of peak is accepted     # anchor_merge_gap = 200,   # Uncomment when input is NOT pre-consolidated     out_dir = out_dir,     project_name = "Example_HiChIP_Integrative"   ) }

Refinement rules (minimum input: H3K4me1 + H3K4me3): Enhancer BED overlap (highest priority): Known enhancer regions (enhancer_bed parameter, e.g. FANTOM5 ENCODE cCREs). Overlapping anchors become E (H3K4me3⁻) dual (H3K4me3⁺). P + H3K4me1⁺ H3K4me3⁺: Resolved bigWig ratio (chromatin_bw) available — dual H3K4me1/H3K4me3 ≥ 3, otherwise P (H3K4me3 dominates). Without bigWig, H3K4me3⁺ always defaults P. E/G + H3K4me1⁺ H3K4me3⁺: Resolved bigWig ratio available — dual H3K4me1/H3K4me3 ≥ 3, P K4me3-dominant. Without bigWig, E/G retain original type (conservative — ratio data required), unlike P defaults P. E/G + H3K4me3⁺ H3K4me1⁻ → P: Unannotated internal promoter. P + H3K4me1⁺ H3K4me3⁻ + (H3K27ac⁺ ATAC⁺) → E: Conservative reclassification requiring active-mark confirmation. G + H3K4me1⁺ H3K4me3⁻ + (H3K27ac⁺ ATAC⁺) → E: Intronic enhancer. eP/eG + H3K4me3⁺ (promoter_like, without H3K4me1) → P: Revert promoter; includes bivalent H3K4me3⁺/H3K27me3⁺. Triple-positive (H3K4me1⁺/H3K4me3⁺/H3K27me3⁺) conflicting_marks retain eP/eG, unless anchor also matches curated enhancer_bed region H3K4me3⁺ (rule 1 — highest priority — reclassifies dual). eP/eG + dual_like: Resolved bigWig ratio available — dual H3K4me1/H3K4me3 ≥ 3, otherwise P (H3K4me3-dominant eG interpreted internal/alternative TSS candidate). Without bigWig, dual-positive (H3K4me1⁺/H3K4me3⁺) anchors retain eP/eG type (conservative — ratio data required resolve promoter vs dual-signature); H3K4me3⁺-anchors (H3K4me1⁻) reverted P. Anchor types matching rule remain unchanged. Optional parameters chromatin_bw (bigWig paths H3K4me1 H3K4me3) enhancer_bed (curated enhancer regions) provide quantitative literature-based evidence refine dual-classification . Without , H3K4me3⁺-anchors (K4me1⁻) reclassified P regardless original type; dual-positive anchors (H3K4me1⁺/H3K4me3⁺) retain original type quantitative ratio data available. chromatin state anchor also inferred (highest-priority match first): conflicting_marks > dual_like > active_enhancer_like > intermediate_enhancer_like > other_enhancer_like > promoter_like > repressed > uncertain > no_data. Important — H3K4me3 dependency: Rules test H3K4me3 absence (e.g., P→E, G→E) require H3K4me3 provided chromatin_beds. H3K4me3 omitted, value NA anchors, rules skipped conservatively — reclassification without explicit data. Include H3K4me3 (optionally H3K27me3) enable full set reclassification rules. Pipeline guidance: two refinement modules serve distinct roles complement — replace one another. Expression-aware refinement evaluates transcriptional activity (gene expressed?) provides activity metrics (Putative_Target_Genes, Retained_In_Functional_Network, Refinement_Action) required downstream GSEA, GO enrichment, differential expression profiling. Chromatin-aware refinement evaluates chromatin identity (anchor?) using direct histone mark evidence, revising positional expression-derived anchor types chromatin-supported categories (E, P, G, dual). expression ChIP-seq data, use expression refinement first chromatin refinement — expression marks silent anchors hypotheses (eP/eG), chromatin supports revises , expression-filtered target columns recomputed stored expression data using updated chromatin-aware anchor types consistent downstream profiling. title: Integrative Suite for Target Assignment and Functional Annotation of Chromatin Interactions
text: Welcome looplook, versatile R/Bioconductor toolkit developed integrate 3D chromatin architecture data (e.g., HiChIP, ChIA-PET, Hi-C) tabular omics datasets, including transcriptomics, chromatin accessibility, protein-DNA interactions (derived ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, CUT&RUN), genetic variants annotated genome-wide association studies. Numerous studies demonstrated many distal regulatory elements physically interact target gene promoters via 3D chromatin loopings, thereby regulating expression genes located tens kilobases megabases away linear genome. However, conventional annotations tend assign putative elements (peaks) nearest genes cis, often fails reflect biological reality. Hence, accurate assignment non-coding genetic variants orphan peaks cognate target genes remains major bottleneck target annotation functional elements. address , looplook systematically prioritizes physical spatial chromatin contacts batch-annotate thousands regulatory elements genome-wide, high-throughput scale, thereby identifying candidate target genes high confidence systematic efficiency. Beyond utility tool integrative target annotation, looplook can used standalone utility loop analysis per se. Even absence auxiliary omics data, systematically annotates 3D chromatin interactome , classifying complex spatial topologies (e.g., Enhancer-Promoter, Promoter-Promoter interactions) quantifying node connectivity uncover dense regulatory hubs enhancer cliques may represent candidate regulatory domains driving cell-type-specific transcriptional programs.

title: Integrative Suite for Target Assignment and Functional Annotation of Chromatin Interactions
text: 3D genomics analyses, individual replicates typically exhibit certain degrees inconsistency noise. consolidate_chromatin_loops function serves foundational data-cleaning module, merging multiple replicates standardized, unified 3D chromatin interaction coordinate framework. Key Parameters: mode: Defines overarching merging algorithm. "consensus" mode (recommended) employs graph-based connected component analysis cluster nearby chromatin loop anchors across biological/technical samples. "intersect" mode applies strict reference-based filtering retain overlapping interactions, "union" mode retains detected interactions exploratory pan-tissue analyses. min_raw_score & min_score (Dual-Filter): min_raw_score acts pre-filter applied individual BEDPE files clustering (e.g., removing singleton noise help reduce computational memory overhead). min_score serves post-filter applied final merged chromatin interactome improve confidence. "consensus" "union" modes, representative score replicate-balanced: package first averages clustered loop scores within replicate, averages across replicates, one replicate denser loop calls dominate final score. gap: Defines maximum spatial distance (base pairs) allowed loop anchors consideration part physical cluster. chaining_policy: Controls transitive chaining (-B B-C merging -C cluster) handled. "warn" (default): emits warning cluster span exceeds chaining threshold; remove affected clusters. "none": silent chaining allowed. "drop": excludes wide chained clusters output. "error": stops error. blacklist_species: Automatically excludes chromatin loops overlapping high-variance, artifact-prone genomic regions (e.g., centromeres, telomeres) integrating official ENCODE blacklist specified species (e.g., "hg38", "mm10"). region_of_interest: Accepts auxiliary BED file (e.g., specific disease-associated locus ChIP-seq peak set) filter loops physical connectivity target genomic region.

title: Integrative Suite for Target Assignment and Functional Annotation of Chromatin Interactions
text: module serves core target mapping engine. resolves locus assignment conflicts rigorous hierarchical pipeline: Functional Biotype Prioritization → Expression Filtering (within selected tier) → Co-Dominant Expression Tiebreaker (retains genes expression least 10% group maximum (within 10-fold range)). biotype priority order can customised via biotype_order parameter (five keywords: protein, small_ncRNA, antisense, lncRNA, pseudogene). advanced control, resolve_gene_conflicts() exposes full conflict-resolution logic standalone function. Key Parameters: target_bed: Specifies auxiliary genomic features interest (e.g., GWAS SNPs, ATAC-seq peaks, transcription factor binding sites) require spatial target gene assignment. expr_matrix_file & sample_columns: Providing RNA-seq matrix allows engine activate Expression Pre-filter Tiebreaker logic, drastically reducing false-positive gene assignments genomic regions harboring multiple genes. biotype_order: Custom ordering biotype categories conflict resolution. Default: c("protein", "small_ncRNA", "antisense", "lncRNA", "pseudogene"). Set c("lncRNA", "protein") prioritise lncRNAs. neighbor_hop: advanced topological parameter 3D chromatin interactome network traversal. Target gene assignment uses neighbor_hop + 1 graph steps capture genes opposite anchors. 0 (default) restricts direct contacts (target genes within 1-hop). 1 additionally includes 2-hop expanded targets exploratory network analysis. Values greater 1 supported. hub_metric: connectivity count use hub detection. "unique_contacts" (default): counts distinct neighbour anchor IDs, robust duplicate/replicate loop rows. "total_loops": counts loop rows (backward compatible; may inflate hub calls unconsolidated replicates). target_priority: Policy prioritising multiple candidate target genes per feature. Applies within primary target links (default path_length <= 1); longer paths reported separately Expanded_Target_Genes compete Assigned_Target_Genes. "promoter_then_distance" (default): within primary links, promoter-linked genes beat gene-body genes, shorter paths breaking ties. "distance_then_role": path-length dominates — closest linked gene wins; equal distance, promoter beats gene-body (legacy behaviour). tss_region: Defines spatial boundary gene promoters relative Transcription Start Site (TSS). Output Data Dictionary: Comprehensive 3D Spatial Catalog module exports multi-layered tabular catalog (e.g., *_Basic_Results.xlsx) detailing spatial interactome: Integrative Target Mapping (target_annotation) Delineates spatial coverage genomic variants/features inputted user. separates strict loop-derived columns (Regulated_promoter_genes, Assigned_Target_Genes) *_Filled fallback columns, records provenance Regulated_promoter_Evidence, Regulated_promoter_Fallback_Evidence, long-format target_gene_links table. keeps promoter-supported loop targets, historical assigned targets, nearest-gene fallback choices traceable rather conflated. 3D Network Architecture (loop_annotation) Resolves biological syntax structural interactome. classifies topological interactions (loop_type, e.g., E-P, P-P) distinguishes biologically relevant Putative_Target_Genes broader, raw physical interaction footprints (All_Anchor_Genes). text: bedpe_file Character. Path BEDPE file (least 6 columns: chr1, start1, end1, chr2, start2, end2). Additional columns beyond 6 retained output; anchor swapping affects columns 1-6. target_bed Optional path BED file genomic features (e.g., ChIP-seq peaks, GWAS SNPs). provided, 1D regions mapped 3D target genes. Default: NULL. txdb TxDb object, package name string, NULL auto-resolve species. Default: NULL. org_db OrgDb object, package name string, NULL auto-resolve species. Default: NULL. species Character. Genome assembly string (e.g. "hg38", "mm10", "danRer11", "dm6"). Default: "hg38". txdb org_db NULL, auto-resolved built-species (hg38/hg19/mm10/mm9); species must pass txdb org_db objects package name strings directly (e.g. txdb = TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene, org_db = "org.Dm.eg.db"). species string also used karyotype ideograms JASPAR motif species filtering. tss_region Numeric vector length 2. Promoter window around TSS bp. Default: c(-2000, 2000) (+/-2 kb; typical mammalian protein-coding genes; may need widening broad domains like HOX clusters, narrowing compact genomes). anchor_merge_gap Integer. Merge loop anchors within many bp chromosome building connectivity graph. Default 0 (merging; anchors must match exactly chr, start, end). Set 50--200 input BEDPE comes directly loop caller without prior replicate consolidation – biological anchor may appear slightly different boundaries different loop rows, otherwise fragment graph. needed input pre-consolidated via consolidate_chromatin_loops. out_dir Character. Output directory Excel results file. Default: "./results". expr_matrix_file Optional path normalised expression matrix (genes x samples). Accepts steady-state RNA-seq (TPM/FPKM), nascent transcription data (NET-seq, PRO-seq, GRO-seq, TT-seq), CAGE-seq. Enables expression-aware conflict resolution. Default: NULL. sample_columns Character vector integer indices. Columns expr_matrix_file average baseline expression. Default: NULL. project_name Character. Prefix output files plot titles. Default: "HiChIP". color_palette Character. RColorBrewer palette name. Default: "Set2". karyo_bin_size Integer. Bin width base pairs (bp) karyotype heatmaps. Default: 1e5 (100 kb). Typical range: 5e4-5e5 depending genome size resolution. neighbor_hop Integer. k-hop ego-network expansion order via igraph::ego(). 0 (default) restricts direct loop contacts. 1 additionally includes 2-hop expanded targets exploratory network analysis. Values greater 1 supported. Target gene assignment searches one additional hop (neighbor_hop + 1) capture genes opposite anchor directly connected loops. hub_percentile Numeric (0-1). Loop-count quantile hub detection. Default: 0.95. Genes distal elements connectivity quantile flagged hubs. minimum floor 3 (promoter-centric) 2 (distal) applied avoid false hubs small datasets. hub_metric Character. connectivity count use hub detection. "unique_contacts" (default): counts distinct neighbour anchor IDs, robust duplicate/replicate loop rows. "total_loops": counts loop rows (backward compatible; may inflate hub calls input contains unconsolidated replicates). min_expr Numeric. Minimum expression value gene considered active anchor-level conflict resolution. Used expr_matrix_file provided. Default: 0 (non-zero expression). Increase 1 higher require stronger evidence. Note: min_expr = 0, code uses strict greater-comparison (> 0) exclude truly undetected genes; min_expr >= 1, uses >= min_expr. nascent transcription data (NET-seq, PRO-seq), gene-body aggregated signal used quantitative input. See refine_loop_anchors_by_expression separate threshold parameter controls promoter reclassification. conflict_strategy Character. Conflict resolution order overlapping gene assignments. "biotype_first" (default): select best biotype tier first, apply expression filtering within tier. "expression_first": apply expression filtering across biotypes first, pick best biotype among expressed candidates. co_dominance_ratio Numeric (0-1). expression tiebreaker step, genes expression >= co_dominance_ratio x max(expression) group retained together. Default: 0.1 (.e. within one order magnitude). Lower values (e.g. 0.01) retain co-dominant candidates; higher values (e.g. 0.5) stringent. biotype_order Character vector. Custom ordering biotype categories gene conflict resolution (passed resolve_gene_conflicts). Five keywords: "protein", "small_ncRNA", "antisense", "lncRNA", "pseudogene". Listed categories get top priority; unlisted keep default relative order appended bottom. Default: c("protein", "small_ncRNA", "antisense", "lncRNA", "pseudogene"). anchor_gap Integer. Candidate search radius bp peak loop anchor. -1L (default): strict physical overlap required. >= 0, expands candidate search window (e.g. 200 cross-experiment coordinate shifts). Note: final retention always requires least anchor_min_overlap bp physical overlap; parameter controls candidates evaluated, whether proximity-pairs retained. anchor_min_overlap Integer. Minimum required physical overlap (bp) peak anchor. Default 1L: least 1 bp actual sequence overlap required – proximity-pairs within anchor_gap window without physical overlap excluded. Increase 10-100 broad peaks avoid spurious boundary overlaps. anchor_min_frac Numeric (0-1). first two filters, fraction peak width must physically overlap anchor? Default 0: fraction accepted. Set 0.1-0.5 peaks broad (e.g. H3K27ac domains, 2-5 kb) 1 bp overlap link entire broad peak. Ignored point features (SNPs, eQTLs). Applied last, pairs passed anchor_gap anchor_min_overlap. write_output Logical. TRUE, write Excel workbook out_dir (default: FALSE). FALSE, return results without creating directories files. quiet Logical. TRUE, suppress progress messages preserving warnings. Default: FALSE. target_priority Character. prioritise among multiple candidate target genes per input feature. policy applies within primary target links (default path_length <= 1); longer paths reported separately Expanded_Target_Genes participate Assigned_Target_Genes selection. "promoter_then_distance" (default): within primary links, strict promoter genes outrank strict gene-body genes, outrank structurally supported strict enhancer candidates; within tier shorter paths win.  Exception: direct strict promoter–promoter contacts (loop, path0 + path1) co-assign endpoints via union, technical endpoint orientation reflect biological regulatory direction. "distance_then_role": within primary links, path-length dominates – closest linked gene wins; equal distance promoter beats gene-body (legacy behaviour). policy affects Assigned_Target_Genes . Regulated_promoter_genes always reports promoter-linked genes regardless chosen policy.

text: Mapping Strategy Fallback Mechanism method prioritizes physical 3D chromatin contacts keeping strict fallback semantics separate. Regulated_promoter_genes reports promoter genes supported loop-anchor context, Assigned_Target_Genes preserves historical promoter-first 3D assignment, *_Filled columns add linear nearest-gene fallback strict 3D assignments empty. Regulated_promoter_Evidence, Regulated_promoter_Fallback_Evidence, target_gene_links provide row-level provenance decisions. Hierarchical Conflict Resolution address complex loci single anchor overlaps multiple promoters (e.g., dense gene clusters bidirectional promoters), function executes 3-step resolution: Biotype Prioritization: Selects highest-priority candidates functional class: Protein Coding > small-ncRNA (miRNA, snoRNA, snRNA, rRNA, scaRNA) > Antisense > lncRNA/ncRNA > Pseudogene. Expression Filter: Within selected biotype tier, excludes transcriptionally silent genes using user-provided expression matrix. gene tier expressed, candidates tier retained. Expression Tiebreaker: Among remaining candidates equal biotype priority, retains genes whose expression >= co_dominance_ratio x group maximum. Default 0.1 (one order magnitude; ~3.3-fold log2 space). co-dominant rule preserves functionally redundant candidates bidirectional promoter pairs, co-expressed partners typically fall within 2-3 fold . Edge case: candidates best biotype tier TPM = 0, retained (tiebreaker distinguish ), may produce multi-gene assignments transcriptionally silent loci. Network Topology Analysis Ego-Network Expansion (neighbor_hop): Implements k-hop neighborhood expansion via igraph::ego(). value 0 restricts direct contacts, 1 includes secondary contacts capture broader regulatory cliques. Hub Detection: Utilizes node-degree quantile threshold (hub_percentile) identify highly connected regulatory elements. Peak-Anchor Overlap Control target_bed provided, three parameters control target peaks matched loop anchors. act cascade increasingly stringent filters: anchor_gap – expands search radius around anchor. anchor_min_overlap – requires minimum physical overlap bp. anchor_min_frac – requires overlap cover minimum fraction peak. table lists suggested starting points common experimental designs. quiet = FALSE (default), function prints diagnostic line reporting many peaks overlapped loop anchors filtering, helping tune thresholds data.

what: Consolidate and Integrate Chromatin Loops from Replicates or Multiple Sources — consolidate_chromatin_loops
title: Consolidate and Integrate Chromatin Loops from Replicates or Multiple Sources — consolidate_chromatin_loops
text: function consolidates chromatin loops multiple BEDPE files. designed two main purposes: Replicate Consolidation: Merging biological technical replicates identify high-confidence, reproducible loops (e.g., 3 replicates H3K27ac HiChIP). Multi-Omics Integration: framework can used identify multi-source consensus integrating datasets various experimental designs, HiChIP assays targeting different factors (e.g., integrating H3K27ac H3K4me3, overlapping Hi-C ChIA-PET). function supports three modes: "consensus": Implements graph-based connected component analysis cluster spatially proximal anchors across samples. retains clusters detected >= min_consensus biological replicates. "intersect": Reference-based filtering. Retains loops File 1 whose anchors overlap loops every file within specified gap tolerance. Coordinates scores inherited File 1 without merging. Important: Intersect mode symmetric. output depends file listed first – loops retained File 1 . Changing file order may produce different results. "union": Retains chromatin interactions across entire cohort, ideal exploratory pan-tissue analyses. Connected-component chaining: Graph-based clustering may transitively chain loci (-B B-C merge, pulling C cluster even far apart). default, warning emitted cluster span exceeds chaining threshold (max(3*gap, 5*med_width*gap/1000)). Use chaining_policy control behavior ("warn", "none", "drop", "error"). Note: default "warn" policy remove affected clusters – inflated coordinates (min(start) max(end) across chained members) flow downstream analyses unchanged. chaining concern downstream overlapping operations, use chaining_policy = "drop" exclude wide clusters, reduce gap prevent chaining forming. also supports two-stage filtering strategy improve signal--noise ratio: Pre-filtering (min_raw_score): Removes low-confidence noise (e.g., singleton reads) raw files merging. Post-filtering (min_score): Filters final consensus loops based aggregated score. Replicate-Balanced Aggregation: "consensus" "union" modes, cluster score computed mean per-source mean scores, one replicate many fragmented calls dominate final representative score.

title: looplook: A Triple-Layer Orthogonal Annotation Framework for Chromatin Interactions — looplook-package
text: looplook classifies loop anchors – fundamental units connecting 3D chromatin contacts downstream peak feature annotation – three-layer orthogonal annotation framework layer integrates independent category experimental evidence: Genomic annotation provides baseline anchor assignment genomic coordinates (TSS gene-body overlap). Expression-aware refinement adds transcriptional-activity context transcriptomic data (CAGE-seq, RNA-seq, TT-seq, SLAM-seq). Chromatin-Aware Refinement supplies orthogonal histone-mark validation (ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, ATAC-seq). anchor-level classifications propagate loop network determine target-gene assignments every auxiliary feature (ChIP-seq peaks, ATAC-seq regions, GWAS variants). layers function independently, users may deploy subset matched available data modalities.

text: Reclassification rules (minimum input: H3K4me1 + H3K4me3): Enhancer BED overlap (highest priority): overlapped anchors become "E" (H3K4me3 absent) "dual" (H3K4me3 present). P + H3K4me1(+) H3K4me3(+) -> "dual" (dual-signature) "P" (H3K4me1 likely promoter shoulder; resolved bigWig ratio >= 3 chromatin_bw provided). eP/eG + canonical strong + active/intermediate enhancer chromatin -> "E" (enhancer identity confirmed). P + H3K4me1(+) H3K4me3(-) (H3K27ac(+) ATAC(+)) -> "E" (conservative: requires active-mark confirmation beyond H3K4me1 alone). eP/eG + canonical strong + active/intermediate enhancer chromatin -> "E" (enhancer identity confirmed; matches P->E rule guarantee outcome whether expression chromatin refinement runs first). eP/eG H3K4me3(+) without H3K4me1(+) -> "P" (revert promoter). includes H3K4me3(+)/H3K27me3(+) bivalent anchors. Triple-positive H3K4me1(+)/H3K4me3(+)/H3K27me3(+) eP/eG anchors classified conflicting_marks retain previous eP/eG type. Peak co-occurrence alone sufficient evidence restoration functional promoter state. E + H3K4me1(+) H3K4me3(+) -> resolved bigWig ratio: me1-dominant -> "dual", unresolved (bigWig) -> keep "E", -me1-dominant -> "P". E + H3K4me3(+) without H3K4me1 -> "P" (unannotated promoter). G + H3K4me1(+) H3K4me3(+) -> three-way bigWig resolution E . G + H3K4me3(+) without H3K4me1 -> "P" (internal promoter). G + H3K4me1(+) H3K4me3(-) (H3K27ac(+) ATAC(+)) -> "E" (conservative intronic enhancer). anchors: unchanged. Required inputs: H3K4me1 H3K4me3 required. BED files must exist contain least one peak (empty required-mark file interpreted genome-wide negative evidence). Optional marks (H3K27ac, ATAC, H3K27me3) provided recorded NA (not_tested), rules depend absence skipped conservatively. Chromatin state inference: anchor also assigned chromatin_state based mark combination (highest-priority match first): "conflicting_marks": H3K27me3+ coexisting active mark (H3K4me1+, H3K27ac+, H3K4me3+, ATAC+)  – bivalent/poised/ambiguous chromatin; takes priority enhancer-like dual-like classifications. "dual_like": H3K4me1+ H3K4me3+ "active_enhancer_like": H3K4me1+ H3K27ac+ ATAC+ "intermediate_enhancer_like": H3K4me1+ H3K27ac+ ATAC+ "other_enhancer_like": H3K4me1+ , H3K27ac+ "promoter_like": H3K4me3+ "repressed": H3K27me3+ (active marks) "uncertain": marks tested none present "no_data": marks tested Candidate anchor selection: candidate_types = NULL (default), five anchor types c("P","G","E","eP","eG") tested regardless input source.  Set candidate_types subset (e.g. c("eP", "eG")) restrict reclassification scope. reclassification, loop_type recomputed updated anchor types. Bivalent / conflicting-mark domains: Anchors H3K27me3+ coexisting alongside active marks (H3K4me3+, H3K4me1+, H3K27ac+) receive chromatin_state = "conflicting_marks". common stem-cell developmental contexts, H3K4me3+/H3K27me3+ bivalent domains poise genes activation maintaining transcriptional silence. reclassification rules distinguish : bivalent double-positive anchors (H3K4me3+ / H3K27me3+, H3K4me1-), restored P retaining conflicting_marks state; triple-positive anchors (H3K4me1+ / H3K4me3+ / H3K27me3+), retain previous eP/eG type co-presence three marks bulk ChIP resolve whether H3K4me1 H3K4me3 come nucleosome, allele, cell. distinguish active poised promoters, run expression refinement chromatin refinement use retained expression state together chromatin_state = "conflicting_marks". chromatin_state column chromatin_validation remains available independent filtering conflicting-mark anchors. title: Expression-Aware refinement of loop anchors and target linkages — refine_loop_anchors_by_expression
text: Algorithmic Framework: Target Filtration: Parses merged gene assignments (e.g., "GeneA;GeneB"), evaluates individual genes defined expression threshold, retains transcriptionally active targets. Biological Reclassification: Reclassifies physically annotated promoters (P) gene bodies (G) lacking active transcription element-Promoter like (eP) element-Genebody like (eG) elements. Important: eP/eG labels denote structural genomic position (near TSS within gene body) – constitute evidence enhancer activity, even though associated gene transcriptionally silent. Orthogonal chromatin data (ATAC-seq, H3K27ac, H3K4me1) required functional regulatory interpretation. e prefix stands element (structurally defined genomic feature akin cis-regulatory element), enhancer. Expression-Aware Connectivity Statistics: Recomputes promoter-centric distal-element connectivity expression-aware anchor refinement, preserving structural loop rows refined loop annotation (anchor types genes reclassified place silent elements). separates complete physical contact map high-confidence active subset. External Target Refinement: Filters auxiliary target mapping columns (e.g., Assigned_Target_Genes_Filled) based expression criteria, ensuring mapped 1D genomic features exclusively linked active genes. Target Provenance Preservation: Recomputes *_Filled membership flags target_gene_links expression filtering, retains structural links expression provenance, appends Mean_Expression, Expression_State, Passes_Expression_Filter. Evidence labels local_promoter_overlap, distal_promoter, linear_fallback preserved. Design Philosophy: function discard structural loop rows based expression state. Hi-C, HiChIP, PLAC-seq capture 3D chromatin contacts; RNA-seq captures current transcriptional state. silent promoter may reflect cell-state, time-point, technical factors rather absence physical contact. However, anchor gene assignments types reclassified place: anchor1_gene/anchor2_gene may set NA anchor types downgraded (e.g. P -> eP, G -> eG) silent regulatory elements. rows retained; high-confidence functional subset provided via Retained_In_Functional_Network Functional Loop Annotation Excel sheet. Interpretation eP/eG labels: eP (element-Promoter like) eG (element-Genebody like) structural positional classifications, functional enhancer classifications. eP anchor resides near TSS structurally promoter-like; eG anchor lies within gene body structurally genebody-like. associated gene may transcriptionally silent current sample – can arise cell-type proportions, time-point effects, sequencing depth, promoter pausing – anchor retains positional identity putative regulatory element. labels treated hypotheses requiring orthogonal validation (ATAC-seq, H3K27ac, H3K4me1, H3K27me3 depletion). Users matched chromatin data overlay eP/eG loci tracks interpreting functionally active regulatory elements. Pipeline guidance: recommended order expression refinement first, chromatin refinement. matched chromatin data available, follow expression refinement refine_loop_anchors_by_chromatin – chromatin evidence resolves eP/eG definitive types (E, P, G, dual), expression-derived columns (Putative_Target_Genes, Promoter_Target_Genes, Retained_In_Functional_Network) carry forward filtered target set downstream profiling. reverse order (chromatin ->expression) unsupported stop. produce incorrect results.
